answer: Correlation-decay quorum monitors pairwise submission similarity, assigning each identity a mirror score; scores above threshold halve voting weight per epoch and block quorum entry. Every identity posts a cedar bond of 50 tokens, pays 2 tokens per attempt, needs 20 distinct-epoch endorsements for full weight, and is capped at 5 attempts/day. A gale of registrations buys no advantage: a ring must fund 50 tokens per fake, burn 2 per synchronized attempt, and wait 20 epochs, yet correlation keeps decaying all its weights together, so the ring cannot assemble an independent quorum.
